originalTitle: S&P 500 notches record-high close as rate-hike worries ease
summary: VIDEO SHOWS: N/A STORY: Wall Street's main indexes ended higher on Thursday, with the Dow ticking up marginally, the S&P 500 adding nearly two-thirds of a percent to close at a record high, and the tech-heavy Nasdaq climbing more than eight-tenths of a percent. Several chip stocks led the way, with shares of Sandisk surging nearly 14% after the memory chip maker said it expects revenue to grow at a mid-to-high-teens percentage rate from fiscal years 2028 to 2030, encouraged by strong demand amid rapid AI infrastructure buildout. On the flip side, shares of Cisco fell more than 8% despite the AI infrastructure company a day earlier forecasting fiscal 2027 revenue above Wall Street expectations. Eric Diton is president and managing director of The Wealth Alliance. "Sandisk up double digits with just great numbers, great expectations for future revenue for margins, which by the way is what took Cisco down today. Cisco beat on earnings, beat on revenue, but the street focused on a little over a 2% drop in margin, and they beat up the stock pretty well. But generally speaking, the Nasdaq's having a great day, up roughly three quarters of a percent, led by the chips." Elsewhere in the market, shares of Netflix climbed more than 5% after billionaire investor Bill Ackman unveiled a new holding in the streaming company as part of Pershing Square's biggest portfolio overhaul in years. And shares of Tapestry plunged more than 16% after the Coach owner forecast muted annual revenue growth. Meanwhile, fresh data showed U.S. producer prices were unchanged in July, while the number of Americans filing claims for unemployment benefits increased moderately last week, pointing to a stable jobs market. Traders are pricing in a more than 60% chance that the Federal Reserve will keep interest rates unchanged at its meeting next month, according to CME's FedWatch tool.

chineseTitle: 随着加息担忧缓解，标准普尔 500 指数收盘创历史新高
chineseSummary: 视频显示：无故事：华尔街主要股指周四收高，道琼斯指数小幅上涨，标准普尔 500 指数上涨近三分之二，收于历史新高，以科技股为主的纳斯达克指数上涨逾十分之八。几只芯片股领涨，其中存储芯片制造商 Sandisk 表示，受人工智能基础设施快速建设带来的强劲需求的推动，预计 2028 至 2030 财年收入将以中位数百分比增长，该公司股价飙升近 14%。另一方面，尽管这家人工智能基础设施公司前一天预测 2027 财年收入高于华尔街预期，但该公司股价仍下跌超过 8%。埃里克·迪顿 (Eric Diton) 是财富联盟的总裁兼董事总经理。 “Sandisk 的股价上涨了两位数，数字非常好，对未来利润率的预期也很高，顺便说一句，这就是思科今天下跌的原因。思科的盈利和收入都表现出色，但华尔街关注的是利润率略高于 2% 的下降，他们的股价表现相当不错。但总的来说，纳斯达克指数今天表现不错，在芯片股的带动下，上涨了大约四分之三。”在市场的其他地方，亿万富翁投资者比尔·阿克曼(Bill Ackman)公布了对流媒体公司Netflix的新持股，作为潘兴广场(Pershing Square)多年来最大的投资组合改革的一部分，该公司股价上涨了5%以上。在 Coach 老板预测年度收入增长放缓后，Tapestry 股价暴跌超过 16%。与此同时，最新数据显示美国7月份生产者价格没有变化，而上周申请失业救济的美国人人数温和增加，表明就业市场稳定。交易员预计美联储维持利率的可能性超过 60%
